picks.editorial_note: Purdue's Rosen Center is a partner on over $42 million in NSF grants to build national-scale AI and data cyberinfrastructure, positioning research computing to support AI-driven science across many institutions.
picks.title: Purdue enables AI- and data- cyberinfras...
picks.university: Purdue Rosen Center for Advanced Computing

picks.editorial_note: A UK government-backed, £5 million multi-institution trial will use AI flight-path adjustments to cut contrail-driven aviation warming, a rare case of AI research moving directly into real-world climate policy testing.
picks.title: Operation Blue Skies takes off: landmark trial to test AI-driven contrail avoidance

picks.editorial_note: Johns Hopkins and Toyota Research Institute are combining AI with high-throughput automated experiments to accelerate battery materials discovery, an industry-academia pairing aimed at a critical energy technology bottleneck.
picks.title: Johns Hopkins team partners with Toyota Research Institute to accelerate new battery discovery

picks.editorial_note: A Kent State researcher's DOE Genesis Mission award will use AI to mine 50 years of water-quality data for critical mineral deposits, tying AI research directly to U.S. critical-minerals supply policy.
picks.title: Kent State Researcher Selected for US Department of Energy Genesis Mission Award to Mine Decades of River Data for Critical Minerals; Kent State Today; July 29, 2026

picks.editorial_note: University of Alabama's selection for DOE Genesis Mission Phase 1 funding to build an AI tool for physics data analysis marks another university's entry into a flagship federal AI-for-science initiative.
picks.title: UA Preview — Aug. 17-23, 2026

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's discovery of 'attribution decay' — that generative AI outputs from very large datasets can't be traced to specific training examples — has major implications for copyright disputes and AI provenance debates.
picks.title: When AI art has no author: MIT study finds generated images often can't be traced to any training data

picks.editorial_note: Tohoku University and Western Digital's new joint lab targets next-generation data storage for AI workloads, addressing an infrastructure bottleneck as AI data demands keep growing.
picks.title: Tohoku University Launches AI Data Infrastructure Lab with Western Digital Corporation

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's computational tools for the MOSAIC multi-modal microscope enable researchers to manage and analyze the massive, heterogeneous datasets it produces, expanding what's scientifically possible with AI-assisted imaging.
picks.title: Building the Computational Mind for the “Swiss Army Knife” of Microscopes

picks.editorial_note: MIT Lincoln Laboratory's ARCADE agentic AI debriefing assistant is being integrated into U.S. Air Force Collaborative Combat Aircraft operations, a notable step of academic AI research into active military deployment.
picks.title: Human–AI mission debrief enters the Air Force through ARCADE

picks.editorial_note: EPFL's STING framework shows AI agents can be manipulated into harmful behavior through multi-turn conversations rather than single bad prompts, a significant finding for AI safety and red-teaming practice.
picks.title: How attackers persuade AI agents to break the rules
